text: Cannot go to another map during the battle!
What?! No! No!! No!!!\nI'm sick of this!!
Hey, adventurer. I heard you defeated the modified\ndragon on Nisel Mountain. You're awesome!
How did it look? ...What? Black crystal?\nHmm, I think I've heard of it before.\nBut... I can't remember.
Do you have them? Why didn't you take a sample...\nWhat?! It disappeared? All of them?\nThat sounds strange...
By the way, what brings you here? ...Oh?\nLook who's here! It's the greedy girl who was in\nthe Reug Salt Plains.
What did you say?! Hmph, whatever.\nWe heard that a wizard called Naiata was here.\nYou guys know where she is?
What, what, what?! What's wrong with you?!
You idiot! Don't ever mention Naiata, Mauez and...\nMajua in front of Mondan!
You'll know when you see it...\nWe don't really know well but something might have\nhappened between Mondan and the three wizards.
She flies off the handle at the mere mention of\nthese names...
Anyway, we'll take care of Mondan.\nJust go find Naiata before she notices. Take care.
Shut up! I smell her! It's Naiata!\nShow yourself, Naiataaaa!!
Phew, we made it. Oh? Hey, look.
Looks like you can go through the gate now.\nGood for you. But...where are those two?
Ugg... I think I'm going to die...
I see! Sounds like you're alright.
How can you talk like that?!\nBe gentle, won't you?!
Sorry for the trouble... I'm alright...
No you're not. You look seriously injured...
We'll go back to Sofya City.\nAdventurer, stay alert. Greedy girl, you too.
Don't call me greedy!\nYou guys be careful too!
Hey! I'm injured, too!\nDon't leave me alone!!
The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
